# WebsiteClosers Business Listings & Sold Deals Scraper

WebsiteClosers is a brokerage for internet, e-commerce, SaaS, agency and service businesses. This actor turns its public marketplace into structured deal rows: live listings, pending deals, keyword matches, a selected set of industries, or the historical sold-deal archive. Every row is built from the listing itself, with the site's own asking price, cash flow, revenue, age, headcount and broker desk when disclosed.

## What it does

- **Browse live listings** - every available and pending business currently on the marketplace.
- **Browse selected industries** - pick one or more of 103 WebsiteClosers categories.
- **Keyword search** - match listing titles and card summaries, optionally the full description.
- **Browse sold deals** - the sold archive for valuation comparables.
- **Look up specific listings** - paste full listing URLs or bare numeric listing IDs.
- **Filter by the numbers** - asking price, cash flow, revenue, year established and employee ranges, or SBA pre-qualified only.
- **Sort like the site** - newest, asking price, cash flow or revenue, in either direction.
- **See only new deals** - optionally skip listings an earlier run with the same filters already returned.
- **Omit what the source hides** - no nulls, blank strings, empty arrays or placeholder zeros.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `browse` | `browse`, `byCategory`, `search`, `closedDeals` or `byUrls`. |
| `categories` | array | Any | One or more industry slugs. Empty means every industry. |
| `searchQueries` | array | Any | Words or phrases matched against titles and summaries. Multiple phrases are OR-ed. |
| `listingUrls` | array | Any | Listing URLs or bare numeric IDs for `byUrls`. |
| `statuses` | array | Any | `available`, `pending`, `sold`; empty keeps every status. |
| `sort` | string | `newest` | `newest`, `priceDesc`, `priceAsc`, `cashFlowDesc`, `cashFlowAsc`, `revenueDesc` or `revenueAsc`. |
| `searchScope` | string | `live` | `live`, `sold` or `both`; used by `search`. |
| `sbaOnly` | boolean | `false` | Keep only listings marked SBA pre-qualified or pre-approved. |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | `true` | Open each listing for revenue, age, employees, categories, broker desk, code name and full description. |
| `searchInDescription` | boolean | `false` | Also search the full description. Slower. |
| `onlyNew` | boolean | `false` | Skip listings returned by an earlier run with the same filters. |
| `minAskingPrice` | integer | - | Drop listings priced below this amount (USD). |
| `maxAskingPrice` | integer | - | Drop listings priced above this amount (USD). |
| `minCashFlow` | integer | - | Drop listings with lower annual cash flow (USD). |
| `maxCashFlow` | integer | - | Drop listings with higher annual cash flow (USD). |
| `minRevenue` | integer | - | Drop listings with lower annual revenue (USD). |
| `maxRevenue` | integer | - | Drop listings with higher annual revenue (USD). |
| `minYearEstablished` | integer | - | Drop listings established before this year. |
| `maxYearEstablished` | integer | - | Drop listings established after this year. |
| `minEmployees` | integer | - | Drop listings with fewer disclosed employees. |
| `maxEmployees` | integer | - | Drop listings with more disclosed employees. |
| `maxItems` | integer | `50` | Hard cap on emitted listings (1â€“5000). |
| `maxConcurrency` | integer | `6` | Simultaneous listing-page requests (1â€“12). |

The default run is deliberately small: browse live listings and return 20 rows.

### Examples

**Live listings with at least $1M cash flow**

```json
{
  "mode": "browse",
  "minCashFlow": 1000000,
  "maxItems": 30
}
```

**Two industries, pending deals first**

```json
{
  "mode": "byCategory",
  "categories": ["software-saas", "ecommerce-online-retail"],
  "statuses": ["pending"],
  "sort": "priceDesc",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

**Keyword search across live and sold deals**

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "searchQueries": ["Amazon FBA", "subscription"],
  "searchScope": "both",
  "maxItems": 40
}
```

**Sold SaaS comparables**

```json
{
  "mode": "closedDeals",
  "categories": ["software-saas"],
  "sort": "revenueDesc",
  "maxItems": 200
}
```

**Exact listings by URL or ID**

```json
{
  "mode": "byUrls",
  "listingUrls": [
    "https://www.websiteclosers.com/businesses/ai-saas-company-google-business-profile-software-2-9m-arr-1-400-active-clients-76-gross-margin-4-9-stars-from-15-000-local-businesses/119826/",
    "119784"
  ]
}
```

**Daily new-listing feed**

```json
{
  "mode": "browse",
  "onlyNew": true,
  "maxItems": 300
}
```

## Output

Each row is one business listing.

**Identity and content**

- `listingId` - numeric WebsiteClosers listing ID
- `title` - full listing headline
- `summary` - short teaser from the card
- `description` - full listing narrative, paragraph breaks preserved
- `sourceUrl` - canonical listing URL
- `status` - `Available`, `Pending` or `Closed`
- `dealStatus` - normalized `available`, `pending` or `sold`
- `datePublished`, `dateModified` - ISO timestamps from the listing page
- `imageUrl` - listing photo
- `hasDetails` - whether the listing page was read
- `foundOn` - the mode or category view that found the row

**Money and business profile**

- `askingPrice` - numeric USD price; absent when the site shows â€œOpenâ€
- `priceText` - price as displayed, for example `$4,600,000` or `Open`
- `cashFlow` - annual cash flow / seller's discretionary earnings in USD
- `revenue` - annual revenue in USD
- `grossIncome` - legacy alias kept for existing integrations; same value as `revenue`
- `currency` - `USD`
- `yearEstablished` - year the business started
- `employees` - disclosed headcount
- `cashFlowMultiple` - asking price divided by cash flow, rounded to two decimals
- `revenueMultiple` - asking price divided by revenue, rounded to two decimals
- `sbaPreQualified` - present and `true` when the listing says SBA pre-qualified or pre-approved

**Classification and broker desk**

- `category`, `categoryName` - primary industry slug and label
- `categories`, `categoryNames` - every industry the listing belongs to
- `businessType` - the business type named in the listing's broker block, for example `SaaS Company`
- `brokerTeam` - the WebsiteClosers desk representing the listing
- `brokerCode` - legacy alias for the WebsiteClosers reference, for example `WC 4158`
- `reference` - WebsiteClosers reference code
- `codeName` - the confidential deal code name, when shown
- `postedBy` - kept for older integrations; the redesigned site no longer publishes an individual poster name

Every row also has `recordType: "businessListing"` and `scrapedAt`.

## How filters behave

- Filters that use a field the listing does not disclose keep the listing rather than guessing. This is deliberate: `minEmployees` should not throw away a deal that simply did not publish headcount.
- `sbaOnly` is different: it requires positive evidence, so a listing without the SBA label is excluded.
- `onlyNew` remembers the IDs returned for the same filter combination in the named key-value store `website-closers-only-new`. The first run behaves normally; later scheduled runs return only newly seen listings.
- `searchInDescription` opens every candidate listing before matching. Without it, search covers titles and card summaries.

## Backward compatibility

Saved tasks built on the previous version keep running. These legacy keys are accepted invisibly and mapped in code:

- `category` â†’ `categories` in `byCategory` mode
- `searchQuery` â†’ `searchQueries`
- `minGrossIncome` / `maxGrossIncome` â†’ `minRevenue` / `maxRevenue`
- `maxResults` â†’ `maxItems`
- `startUrls` â†’ `listingUrls`
- `details` â†’ `includeDetails`
- `proxyConfiguration` â†’ ignored; the site is read directly

All previous output fields are retained. `grossIncome` and `brokerCode` are kept as aliases beside the newer `revenue` and `reference` fields.

## FAQ and limits

**Does this need a proxy or login?**
No. WebsiteClosers serves these pages publicly, and the actor reads them with plain HTTP. No cookies, account or proxy setup is required.

**Are asking prices always numbers?**
No. Some sellers publish â€œOpenâ€. Those rows keep `priceText: "Open"` and omit `askingPrice`.

**Why are some fields missing on some rows?**
WebsiteClosers only publishes what each broker discloses. Undisclosed fields are omitted, never filled with `0`, `null` or a guess.

**Is revenue the same as gross income?**
Yes. The site labels it â€œRevenueâ€. `grossIncome` is retained as a backward-compatible alias.

**Do I get the seller's contact details?**
No. The actor reads public listing pages only and does not submit contact or NDA forms. Use `sourceUrl` to contact WebsiteClosers.

**Why is there no location?**
WebsiteClosers does not publish a business location on these listing pages; confidentiality is part of the brokerage model.

**How fresh is the data?**
Every run reads the live site. There is no cached copy.

**What are the hard limits?**
The sold archive is historical: some old pages no longer exist, and those rows keep the card asking price and cash flow with `hasDetails: false`. Some industries currently have only sold deals; live modes return nothing for them, so use `closedDeals` with that category. `onlyNew` tracks emitted IDs per filter combination and does not detect price or status changes. Individual seller contacts, private financial statements and NDA-gated documents are not public. The site shows a code name rather than the business's real name.
